memory_update.text: AXTI is the cleanest direct underfollowed relationship in the chunk: upstream InP substrates plus China export-permit timing beneath AI optical interconnect demand.
LITE should be retained as a reference demand validator for InP lasers and photonic components, not as the primary underfollowed alpha candidate.
VECO is a second-order equipment hypothesis: relevance depends on whether optical-interconnect capacity expansion requires its compound-semiconductor or photonics process tools.
CAMT maps to the HBM and advanced-packaging inspection/metrology node; next layer must verify customer breadth and whether HBM/chiplet exposure is material rather than narrative.
TGB maps to sulphuric-acid process-chemistry exposure in copper SX-EW/in-situ recovery; the key edge is contract quality and delivery reliability, not headline copper beta.
USAR is a speculative-to-hypothesis domestic magnet-finishing candidate; survival requires proof of commercial production, qualified customers, and feedstock security.
UUUU is a hidden rare-earth separation candidate inside a uranium company; the key relationship is Dy/Tb oxide supply to magnet makers, not finished magnets.
LEU is a reference bottleneck for HALEU/enrichment and should be used to benchmark policy-backed regulated capacity economics.
POWL maps to AI data-center electrical balance-of-plant through medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter power architecture; repeat orders are the key validation signal.

Need primary filings and earnings-call verification for all ticker-level claims because much of the current evidence is from external search context and cached Layer 1/2A summaries rather than direct company filings.

Need market-pricing checks for each candidate: current market cap, EV/sales or EV/EBITDA where relevant, analyst count, liquidity, short interest, recent relative performance, and whether the chokepoint is already discounted.

Need falsification triggers for each node: export-permit normalization for AXTI, customer capex cuts for CAMT/VECO, acid availability normalization for TGB, qualification failures for USAR/UUUU, DOE delays for LEU, and one-off order risk for POWL.

summary: Mapped ticker relationships for the provided candidate chunk across four hotspot nodes: InP optical-interconnect substrates/devices, HBM and advanced-packaging inspection, sulphur/sulphuric-acid exposed copper SX-EW, heavy rare-earth and magnet localization, nuclear fuel/HALEU, and AI data-center electrical balance-of-plant. AXTI, CAMT, VECO, TGB, USAR, UUUU, and POWL remain the main underfollowed-lane candidates. LITE and LEU are retained as reference comparables because they help validate demand pull and regulated bottleneck economics, but they should not crowd out smaller supplier-layer work.
